sections.label: Intro
sections.intent: Sparse introduction with pad, texture, and hook motif.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.intent: First verse, leave space for vocal, sparse drums and bass.

sections.label: Pre-Chorus
sections.intent: Build tension with quarter-note kick, rising pad, and sweep.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.intent: Full chorus, four-on-the-floor, wide chords and backing countermelody.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.intent: Second verse with varied rhythmic and melodic material.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.intent: Final chorus, denser arrangement with ride and active bass.

sections.label: Outro
sections.intent: Fading outro with pad and rain texture.
